_provenance.note: Priors for the third real-paper decomposition (Epic AI): the two DIFFERENT-FIELD results Gibbs & Candes' adaptive conformal inference builds on, lifted into grounded dgroups by an in-session sub-agent. Sharing functor vocabulary with grounding/dgroups/aci_paper.json so set-cover explains the paper as {online no-regret machinery} + {conformal prediction-set machinery} + a residual that is its genuine cross-field contribution: coverage achieved via online no-regret adaptation under distribution shift. Unlike the Nesterov (all-optimization) and counterfactual (all-conformal) decompositions, this one is covered by priors from TWO fields. Grounded; checked by grounding.verify.
